visual.general_description: Two-panel colour photograph (A, B) of intraoperative tissue and a removed appendix with fragments, annotated with coloured arrows.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A shows an abdominal wall incision with gauze, instruments and a reddish tissue segment marked by a purple arrow and a yellow-orange arrow. Panel B shows a removed curved reddish tissue segment on gauze marked by a yellow arrow, with several brownish fragments marked by purple arrows. The caption names the arrows yellow and pink; the pink arrows appear purple-magenta in the image.

panels.general_description: Color operative photograph of an abdominal wall incision with gauze, instruments and a reddish tissue segment, marked with two arrows.
panels.detailed_description: Close view of dark brown skin of the abdomen with a small umbilicus-like depression near the lower centre and a small cut at the edge of a white gauze pad. A reddish-pink tubular tissue segment with orange-yellow fatty material lies on the gauze beside a pooled red area at the incision edge. A long metal instrument with a forked tip crosses the lower left, another thin metal instrument reaches in from the top, and a gloved hand is visible at the upper left. A solid purple arrow points downward at the reddish tissue on the gauze and a horizontal yellow-orange arrow points left at the incision edge near the umbilicus-like depression. The printed panel letter A appears in purple italics at the bottom. No legible text, scale or date is visible in the panel.
